[b]--- [u]April 2025 Cordonite Presidential Election Result[/u] ---[/b]

The voting period has now ended as of the 30th of April, 2025. Therefore, I hereby declare an end to the voting period.

[b]The results are as follows:[/b]

[nation]United Hydronia[/nation] (9):
- [nation]British Republic of Bob[/nation]
- [nation]Empire of Dabiristan[/nation]
- [nation]Goleornacha[/nation]
- [nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation]
- [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation] (ULR)
- [nation]Sikirsk[/nation]
- [nation]Tulunid[/nation]
- [nation]Yasuya[/nation]
- [nation]Zeitreich[/nation]

[nation]Dhornaper[/nation] (5):
- [nation]Bantarus[/nation]
- [nation]Demste[/nation]
- [nation]Irocco[/nation]
- [nation]States of Arenenge[/nation]
- [nation]Zharvekia[/nation]

[nation]States of Arenenge[/nation] (2):
- [nation]New Westmore[/nation]
- [nation]Sanguivallis[/nation]

Atheist State ([nation]Hezen-Suriya[/nation]) (0):

[nation]Orphogron[/nation] (0):

---

[u]Data Crunching:[/u]
This election had a turnout of 16 citizens voting. This is a 6 vote increase from the previous election held in March of 2025. According to the Shahzada citizen register, there are 28 registered citizens. This means that ~57% of those eligible to vote, decided to vote. Furthermore, none of the candidates from the previous March 2025 President Election ran in this election. Despite this, there was a total of five candidates that ran in this election, an increase of one from the four candidates that ran in the March 2025 Presidential Election. Hydronia received ~56% of the vote, with Dhornaper coming in at second place by winning ~31% of the total votes. Arenenge also scored a few votes, earning ~13% of the total vote. The remaining two candidates did not score any votes.

---

[u]Official Cordonite Council Statement on Hydronia's election:[/u]
Congratulations to [b]United Hydronia[/b] for being elected in as the second President of Cordone. Cordone's citizens have entrusted Hydronia with the duty of leading and further growing the region. We have little doubt that Hydronia will be on par, if not exceed, all expectations that the citizens of Cordone have formed. Best of luck to him and his future cabinet.

---

[u]Wiki Article[/u]:
https://cordone.miraheze.org/wiki/April_2025_Presidential_Election

Glory to Cordone!
